en: An old black‑and‑white postcard view of a rural settlement at the foot of a hillside. A broad unpaved road runs through the village, lined with small houses with tiled roofs. In the background, on the slope of the hill, stands a bright twin‑towered church dominating the landscape. The print is slightly faded and spotted, and a caption is printed along the bottom edge of the image.
